verdict.rationale: Fathom has a public pricing page that lists plan features such as unlimited recordings, AI summaries, CRM field sync, coaching scorecards, custom meeting bot and SSO/SCIM, and the FAQ refers to multiple plans. That shows some self-serve pricing transparency, but the evidence never shows a free tier, dollar prices per tier, or which features belong to which tier. Missing for 10: an evidenced free plan, explicit per-tier prices, a feature-to-tier mapping, confirmation that no tier requires contacting sales, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start free and see exactly what each paid tier costs and adds — no "talk to sales" wall for basic use
